name: 1169-runtime-layout
about: a mod built with LumaScript runtime layout 2 that calls a function of a mod built with layout 1 (same signature) is refused by name, L513, before the signature; the mod it needs loads and starts; the start's check refuses it first (L513 from the kept reports' runtime layouts), so the kernel's own bind sentence is not reached

expect.log: mods: k1-layout-user: THIS MOD HAS ERRORS

has.text: k1-layout-user: code/windows-x64/mod.dll: k1-layout-user is built with LumaScript runtime layout 2 and k1-layout-lib, whose k1.layout it calls, with layout 1. Rebuild the older one with a current LumaLink, or update it.

k1-layout-user: code/linux-x64/mod.so: k1-layout-user is built with LumaScript runtime layout 2 and k1-layout-lib, whose k1.layout it calls, with layout 1. Rebuild the older one with a current LumaLink, or update it.

k1-layout-user: code/macos-arm64/mod.dylib: k1-layout-user is built with LumaScript runtime layout 2 and k1-layout-lib, whose k1.layout it calls, with layout 1. Rebuild the older one with a current LumaLink, or update it.
